name: Perjury
overview: Scripture clearly condemns perjury as a serious sin against both God and neighbor, as seen in Leviticus 6:2-7 where lying, deceiving, or swearing falsely requires restitution and a trespass offering to atone for the offense. The passage emphasizes that false swearing not only harms others but also breaks the covenant relationship with the LORD, necessitating sincere repentance and divine forgiveness through the prescribed sacrificial system. This teaches believers the gravity of truthful speech and the need for integrity before God.
